tier.description: production: org rulesets enforce and the nightly audit checks. development: no deletion or force-push, audited. experiment: free for all.

branch_model.description: github-flow: main only. gitflow: dev (default) -> test -> main, promotions only.

source.description: own: code we write; the security checks apply. upstream-mirror: a mirror of someone else's project; the audit skips the security-ci, gate and draft checks.
